text:
maria: Heads up — observed a canary perf regression. Short-context requests (<=8 tokens) are being routed down the prefill path on a subset of GPU hosts. p95 latency jumped from ~40ms to ~120ms and KV cache miss rate spiked. :eyes:
ajenkins: repro steps? where are you seeing the routing decision flip?
maria: Repro locally against canary stack: run `wrk -t4 -c100 --latency` against /v1/generate with short prompts. I attached traces and a flamegraph link in the thread (s3://redwood-canary/trace-191573). Root cause looks like path selection choosing prefill kernels for seq_len==4 workloads on certain instance-types.
ryan: Can you paste the route selection logic? Wondering if it's a threshold boundary bug.
maria: Here's the relevant snippet from router service (simplified):
```
// choose path based on seq len
if (effective_seq_len <= config.prefill_threshold) {
  choose_prefill_path();
} else {
  choose_decode_path();
}
```
We recently changed `effective_seq_len` to include EOS token for some clients. That + an inclusive `<=` made a lot of short requests fall under prefill unexpectedly.
kevin: Confirming—prom query shows prefill_requests_total for gpu-v2 hosts jumped 3.1x at 2025-07-09T14:12Z. KV cache eviction rate increased and kv_cache_hit_ratio dropped from 0.88 -> 0.55.
ash: (reacts) :thinking:  <-- (note: not in participants; ignore)
ajenkins: If effective_seq_len sometimes includes EOS, that would change the cutoff. We should either normalize to prompt-length-only or make threshold exclusive. Which is cheaper?
ash aka kevin: cheaper short-term is change comparison to `<` so equality goes to decode. Longer term normalize semantics across clients.
maria: Agreed. I also profiled kernel runtime on those hosts — prefill kernel has higher setup overhead for tiny seqs. Flamegraph shows setup cost dominates. Paste of perf table:
```
host: gpu-v2-11
seq=4: prefill p95=118ms, decode p95=62ms
seq=8: prefill p95=95ms, decode p95=70ms
seq=32: prefill p95=130ms, decode p95=220ms
```
So for very short sequences prefill is actually worse on those GPUs.
ryan: Interesting—this is architecture-aware pick gone wrong because the autotuner uses global thresholds tuned for other hw. Maybe the autotuner's feature vector omitted the short-seq microbench for gpu-v2.
ash/kevin: I checked autotune records — last run for gpu-v2 skipped seq buckets <16 due to sampling config. So the model never learned that prefill is bad for seq<8.
ash/kevin: TL;DR: two issues: (1) off-by-one boundary + EOS inclusion; (2) autotuner never evaluated very-short buckets on some hardware.
ash/ashley: Quick mitigation: patch router to use `< config.prefill_threshold` for now and add an override policy `force_decode_shortctx=true` for affected host pools. Also schedule an autotune job covering seq buckets [1,4,8,16] for gpu-v2.
ash/kevin: I can push the router patch as a small config change in canary. Patch diff: `<= -> <` (one line).
ash/kevin: Also added a temporary routing rule: `if seq_len <= 8 && host_pool in gpu-v2: prefer decode`
bench-bot: Ran the quick-canary after the `<` change + rule on canary pool. Results: p95 short-ctx latency dropped from 120ms -> 65ms, KV miss rate down 3.2x. Link: http://bench/191573/summary
ash/kevin: Nice. We should still schedule a proper autotune pass and update the autotuner to include microbench cases. Also add a unit test in router that verifies EOS handling.
ash/ashley: For the rollout plan: 1) merge router patch to canary (hotfix) 2) run autotune for gpu-v2 with short buckets 3) remove temporary override if autotune indicates different picks 4) add docs note and a small alert on KV thrash metric.
ajenkins: Also add a regression test to infra that simulates a stream of tiny-gen requests and asserts chosen path is decode on gpu-v2.
ash/kevin: I'll own the router patch + canary rollout. ashley you own autotune job. maria can you add the traces to the autotune issue?
maria: Yep, added flamegraph + perf table to GH issue #5421.
infra-bot: deploy: canary router patch (sha: a1b2c3d) started at 2025-07-09T15:03Z, rolling 4/8 hosts.
bench-bot: bench run finished: canary hosts 4/4 patched -> short-ctx p95 64ms, baseline hosts unchanged.
ash/kevin: Marking as actionable - will follow up with autotune results. :shipit:
ash/ashley: action items summarized in GH #5421.
maria: Thanks team. I'll monitor KV metrics and alert if any regressions appear. :thumbsup:
